comparison.objective: Fit a funnel and pour beads into a narrow-neck bottle; candidate sets and locks gripper geometry.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool selection, funnel insertion, jug handling, and granular pouring versus hex-driver/wrench counterholding and articulated testing.
comparison.success_condition: Credit follows delivered bead count, with full score for at least 22 of 24 settled beads; candidate scores retained angular setting and lock integrity.
comparison.reason: Granular transfer through a selected funnel is a different tested ability from coupled threaded adjustment.
